description: Scores how ready a small business is to put AI tools to work, out of 100, from eight yes or no questions (digital records, one customer system, written processes, known repetitive tasks, current AI use, an owner, a clear website, time to bed in), and names the two biggest gaps. Free, no key. Docs: https://aeolookup.com/ai-calculators/ai-readiness-score/

digital.description: Most of your business records are in software, not on paper or in heads (15 points).

onePlace.description: Customer details live in one system (a CRM, booking or accounts tool), not scattered across inboxes (15 points).

owner.description: One person is responsible for trying AI in the business (10 points).

processes.description: Your routine jobs (quoting, booking, onboarding, invoicing) follow written steps (15 points).

repetitive.description: You can name the three most repetitive tasks in your week (10 points).

time.description: You could give a new tool two or three hours a week for a month to bed in (15 points).

using.description: Someone on the team already uses an AI assistant such as ChatGPT or Copilot every week (10 points).

website.description: Your website answers customers' common questions clearly, so AI assistants can find and quote you (10 points).

name: score_ai_readiness
title: AI readiness score
